name: IDOT cameras: control points and zones
description: The three SAGE cameras at IDOT rail crossings as the Cities in Motion workshop team set them up, one row per point: 15 control points, each a pixel of the camera's snapshots (x_px, y_px) and where it lies on the ground in UTM zone 16N, EPSG:26916 (easting_m, northing_m), from Joao's scripts (joao_scripts/reprojection_w042.py, joao_scripts/animated_map_w065.py, joao_scripts/animated_map_w06E.py), and the 60 vertices of each camera's four zones in pixels, a lane before or after the crossing, from Zahra's files (zahra/W042_bounding_boxes.json, zahra/W065_bounding_boxes.json, zahra/W06E_bounding_boxes.json), their keys written in words. image_width and image_height are the size of the camera's snapshots, and day is the UTC day the team studied. Read from isalva2/cities-in-motion-video at commit cf66012d663f. Used with the permission of its authors.
